integrity: The infinite proof is graph-theoretic and symbolic. Finite computation only replays small Golden-Mean de Bruijn instances and is not used to infer the theorem.
limitations: The theorem covers the natural inhomogeneous two-map contraction pair \(\rho,\rho^2\) under strong separation; it does not resolve arbitrary commensurable or incommensurable contraction vectors. Historical novelty retains residual risk from unindexed or later-posted work.
title: Positive critical periodic content for the \(\{\rho,\rho^2\}\) contraction pair
